The '''Kashyyyk oil refinery''' was an [[Oil/Legends|oil]] refinery located on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In the waning days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attempted to destroy the facility. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], aided by Wookiee resistance fighters, held them off until the arrival of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. With the help of the diminutive Jedi Master, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were able to push the Confederate forces back.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
If destroyed, the oil refinery would explode and blow up the entire battlefield, resulting in defeat. The battle around it is presumably part of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], which takes place just before the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].
